ideas.name: Xrager
ideas.description: The online preview was excellent — two truly engaging chapters. Looking forward to the full release on Amazon. Hopefully it will be available soon.

ideas.name: Lucas Torres
ideas.description: I'm from São Paulo and learned to code on a TK90X in 1987. Nobody outside Brazil ever writes about those machines. Your section on Latin America made me emotional — someone finally told our story. The only thing missing is a mention of the MSX Hotbit, which was huge here. Maybe in a future update?

ideas.name: کاوه
ideas.description: پیام خط ۹۹۰ رو دیدم نشستم نگاش کردم تا تموم شد بعد دوباره نوشته شد بعد دوباره پاک شد. هیپنوتیزم شدم کسی که اینو طراحی کرده یا نابغه است یا دیوانه

ideas.name: Tommy
ideas.description: I said just one quick look. By 3 AM I had read five chapters to the end This site is a trap 😎

ideas.name: The Abandonware Ring - Z80 Story
ideas.description:
Hey guys!

My name is Martin and I’m the current webmaster at The Abandonware Ring (www.abandonwarering.com). Just wanted to check the status of your site, I know it hasn’t been updated in a while but I still see it online. If you have a minute to chat, you can join our Discord server (https://discord.gg/hWQE85BEk) and we can help out with any needs!

Let me know! 

Thanks,

Martin

ideas.name: c64spark
ideas.description:
Thank you all for the warm and encouraging messages. Your support truly means a lot and keeps me going with even more energy.

A special thanks to Martin for taking the time to share his thoughts and website link. If you'd like, Martin, you're more than welcome to add your link to the "Retro Network" section so other visitors can discover it as well.
